question: What effect is attributed to merely hearing this knowledge, O fair-faced one?
premises: The verse refers to this mere knowledge.
The knowledge is described as heard.
The addressee is addressed as fair-faced one.
inference: Even the mere hearing of this knowledge is presented as efficacious.
uncertainties: The main clause continues in the next verse.
plain_english: O fair-faced one, by this mere knowledge, heard and received...
